notes.title: Update Note for version 0.67
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've fixed a bug in the game that appeared in one of our last version, where HTC Vive controllers didn't track.

We want to thank our amazing community for spotting this regression issue and helping us to solve it.
Thanks to you, this issue is also solved in our Beta for Retropolis 2.

Best,
Asaf from Peanut Button

notes.title: New Languages Update
notes.content:
Hey Bots! 

The first update to The Secret of Retropolis is now live, and the major addition is UI and subtitles to many new languages: German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Japanese and Hebrew.

To stay tuned for more Retropolis news you can follow The Secret of Retropolis on [url=https://twitter.com/button_peanut]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.peanutbutton.net/mailinglist]join our mailing list[/url].

Cheers,
The Peanut Button Team

notes.title: Our demo will be available until July 21st
notes.content:
Hey everybody.

We want to thank everyone who played the Demo and gave us feedback. It's truly heartwarming to see  players connecting with the style of the game and waiting to see what happens next in the story. For those who didn't play it yet, the demo will be playable until the [b]full game releases on July 21st[/b].

And for those who missed our Steam Next Fest livestreams, we're attaching the recording at the bottom of this announcement. 

There were two issues that were brought to our attention regarding the demo:
1. The mirror in Philip's office is pixelated, and slows down frame rate on lower end machines - we came up with a fix that will be included in the full game.
2. On the knuckles controllers - resting the hand on the grip button prevents interacting at the same time - we're currently working on a revised controller binding that solves this for the demo as well as the full game.

If you're experiencing any other issues, technical or other, let us know in the community hub. :)

Last but not least, we wanted to let you know that [b]tomorrow we'll be posting some major news[/b] about the game's release on July 21st. [url=http://peanut button.net/mailinglist]Join our mailing list[/url] so you don't miss them (and get free Retropolis digital posters).

Take care,
The Peanut Button crew.
